participation.context: Does not see the king's page.

story.body: You set the afternoon down as a fact without a name. You kept the king upstairs and the comedy's book in Garnish's hand.

title: Did not put the part's name on the leaf

participation.context: Wrote the phrase and left the name off.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Has the proverb in his mouth, and does not have the page.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You set the afternoon down as a fact without a part, and you put the phrase under Tuesday's line. The king's page stayed with the cat.
